title: Total circuit current
description: Essential: The student's final answer for part (1) must be approximately 0.67 A (or 2/3 A).

title: Capacitor charge value
description: Essential: The student's final answer for part (2) must be approximately 1.6 × 10⁻³ C (or 1.6 mC).

title: Correct series resistance
description: Important: The student must correctly sum R₁, R₂, and r to find the total resistance for part (1).

title: Voltage across capacitor
description: Important: The student must recognize that the stable capacitor voltage equals the voltage across R₂.

title: Apply Q = CV
description: Important: The student must correctly use the capacitance equation Q = C U₂ with consistent units.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The student converts μF to F correctly and maintains consistent SI units throughout.

title: Misidentifying capacitor voltage
description: Pitfall: The student incorrectly uses the source EMF or voltage across R₁ as the capacitor voltage.

title: Internal resistance omission
description: Pitfall: The student forgets to include the internal resistance r in the total series resistance.
